title: Restaurant
description: Restaurant listing with cuisine type, location, contact information, rating, price range, opening hours, delivery availability, and images. Used for restaurant discovery platforms, food delivery apps, and dining guides.

description.description: Description of the restaurant, cuisine, and dining experience

cuisine.description: Cuisine type (e.g., Italian, Japanese, Mexican, Indian, Fusion)

city.description: City where the restaurant is located

country.description: Country where the restaurant is located

latitude.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the restaurant

longitude.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the restaurant

rating.description: Average customer rating, typically on a scale of 1-5

delivery.description: Whether the restaurant offers delivery service

image.description: URL to the restaurant's main image
